description: Implementation of an InputStream that performs asynchronous read-ahead buffering to optimize disk I/O in Spark. It maintains two buffers and manages concurrent read operations, exceptions, and stream closing.

classes.name: ReadAheadInputStream
classes.description: A custom InputStream that asynchronously reads ahead from an underlying input stream using double buffering and concurrency control.

methods.name: ReadAheadInputStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffers and underlying input stream with specified buffer size.

methods.name: isEndOfStream
methods.description: Checks if the end of stream has been reached based on buffer states.

methods.name: checkReadException
methods.description: Throws stored exceptions if a read was aborted due to an error.

methods.name: readAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read from the underlying input stream into the read-ahead buffer.

methods.name: closeUnderlyingInputStreamIfNecessary
methods.description: Closes the underlying input stream if conditions permit.

methods.name: signalAsyncReadComplete
methods.description: Signals completion of an asynchronous read operation.

methods.name: waitForAsyncReadComplete
methods.description: Waits for an ongoing asynchronous read to complete.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a byte or bytes from the active buffer, triggering async read if needed.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the active and read-ahead buffers.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns total remaining bytes in both buffers.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over bytes in the stream, utilizing buffers and underlying stream.

methods.name: skipInternal
methods.description: Internal method to perform skip operation assuming lock is held.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream, shutting down executor and closing underlying stream if safe.
